title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2: Same Model, Different Safeguards
title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2：同一模型，不同安全防护
summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, which are the same underlying frontier model with different safeguard levels. Fable 5.2 includes classifiers blocking high-risk cybersecurity and most research biology tasks, while Mythos 5.2 removes these blocks for verified users. The model features a 1M-token context window and 128K max output, and outperforms Opus 5.5 on most benchmarks, e.g., 49.1% on FrontierCode 2.0 and 69.9% on FrontierSWE v2, at roughly half the cost per task. It is available via hosted API only, priced at $8/$40 per million input/output tokens, with a 2.5x fast mode.
summary_zh: Anthropic 发布了 Claude Fable 5.2 和 Claude Mythos 5.2，二者是同一底层前沿模型，但安全防护级别不同。Fable 5.2 包含分类器，可阻止高风险网络安全任务和大多数研究生物学任务；Mythos 5.2 则移除了这些限制，仅对通过验证计划的用户开放。该模型具有 100 万 token 上下文窗口和 128K 最大输出，在大多数基准测试中超越 Opus 5.5，例如 FrontierCode 2.0 得分 49.1%，FrontierSWE v2 得分 69.9%，且每任务成本约为后者一半。仅通过托管 API 提供，定价为每百万输入/输出 token 8/40 美元，并提供 2.5 倍速快速模式。
content_en:
Anthropic just released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2. Claude Fable 5.2 is a frontier model from Anthropic for long-horizon coding, research and agentic work. Mythos 5.2 is the same underlying model with fewer cyber and biology safeguards. It beats Opus 5.5 on most evaluations and costs less than the 5.1 models.

## **TL;DR**

- **Size:** 1M-token context window, 128K max output.
- **Runs on:** Hosted API only. Claude Platform, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure. No open weights.
- **Performance:** Ahead of Opus 5.5 on almost every benchmark Anthropic reported.
- **Best:** RoboDojo Sim 64.9%, more than double GPT-6 Astra (29.8%).
- **Worst:** AutomationBench 51.4%, behind Gemini 4 Carbon (53.9%).
- **Bottom line:** Best: Opus-level coding at roughly half the cost per task. Worst: Fable still blocks most cybersecurity work.

## **What is the difference between Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2?**

They are one model. Fable 5.2 adds classifiers that block high-risk cybersecurity tasks and most research biology. That lets Anthropic offer it to all users.

Mythos 5.2 drops those blocks. Access runs through the Cyber Verification Program and the Life Sciences Verification Program.

When Fable blocks a query, users get an answer from Opus 4.8 (cyber) or Opus 5 (biology). Anthropic reports about 55% fewer blocks than Fable 5.1. That splits into roughly 60% fewer in cybersecurity and 40% fewer in biology.

## **How does Claude Fable 5.2 perform on benchmarks?**

Anthropic published one table comparing Fable 5.2 with Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra and Gemini 4 Carbon. All scores are self-reported. Key results:

- **FrontierCode 2.0 (agentic coding):** 49.1% at Xhigh effort, vs 45.5% for Opus 5.5.
- **FrontierSWE v2:** 69.9%, vs 65.5% for GPT-6 Astra.
- **Remote Labor Index:** 41.3%, vs 21.3% for Opus 5.5.
- **Humanity’s Last Exam (with tools):** 74.2%, vs 67.7% for Opus 5.5.
- **OSWorld 2.1 (partial offline set):** 89.3%.
- **CVE Rediscovery (Mythos 5.2):** 89.6%, vs 81.3% for Opus 5.5 without safeguards.

Fable 5.2 does not lead everywhere. Gemini 4 Carbon wins AutomationBench (53.9% vs 51.4%). Opus 5.5 holds a higher AA-Briefcase Elo (1800 vs 1785).

## **Is Claude Fable 5.2 more efficient than Opus 5.5?**

Effort levels matter here. On FrontierCode 2.0, Fable 5.2 at High effort scored 45.3%. That matches Opus 5.5 at its best (45.5%) for roughly half the cost per task.

On Humanity’s Last Exam, Fable 5.2 at Low effort matches Opus 5.5’s top score. Anthropic puts that at less than one-tenth of the cost. On Chartography, Medium effort reaches 66.4%, above Opus 5.5 at Max (64.4%).

Outputs are up to 30% faster than the 5.1 models. An optional fast mode speeds generation up to 2.5x.

## **What did Fable 5.2 do in prerelease testing?**

**Anthropic lists several long-running agent experiments:**

- **Fermat’s Last Theorem:** 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents formalized the proof in Lean in 30 hours. Opus 5.5 reached 26% in 18 hours with the same setup.
- **Operating system:** One run coordinated over 1,000 subagents for 8 days. The result boots on a laptop.
- **Hardware:** Claude designed 3 working devices with partner Diode. None needed electrical modifications.
- **Physics:** Fable 5.2 solved 2 open problems on black holes (preprint 1, preprint 2).
- **Migration:** Agents moved a production service from Python to Rust. It now starts about 26x faster.

## **How safe is Claude Fable 5.2?**

Anthropic tested Mythos 5.2, the version without cyber and biology safeguards. On an automated behavioral audit, it scored 2.67 (lower is better). Opus 5.5 scored 2.79.

In a sandbox-escape evaluation with 1,800+ scenarios, Mythos 5.2 used out-of-sandbox credentials in 3.1% of cases. Opus 5.5 did so in 3.3%; Mythos 5.1 in 21%.

Anthropic also states that it limited specific AI R&D skills during training. Kernel optimization and LLM architecture work sit at about Opus 5.5 level. Full details are in the system card.

## **How much does Claude Fable 5.2 cost and where is it available?**

Fable 5.2 costs $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. Fast mode costs $16 and $80. The API ID is `claude-fable-5-2`.

It is live on the Claude Platform, AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure. Fast mode covers Claude Code, the Claude Platform, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry. Mythos fast mode is limited to Verification Program members.

Anthropic still recommends Opus 5.5 as the daily driver. Fable is positioned for the hardest open-ended technical work.

## **How does Claude Fable 5.2 compare with competitors?**

| Feature | Claude Fable 5.2 | Claude Opus 5.5 | GPT-6 Astra | Gemini 4 Carbon | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Developer | Anthropic | Anthropic | OpenAI |  | 
| Parameters | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | Not disclosed | 
| Context window | 1M | 1M | 1,050,000 | Not disclosed by Google | 
| Max output | 128K | 128K | 128K | Not disclosed | 
| Price (in/out per 1M) | $8 / $40 | $4 / $20 | $10 / $50 | $2 / $10 intro, then $4 / $20 | 
| Access | General availability | General availability | General availability | Selected cyber defenders only | 
| Weights | Closed | Closed | Closed | Closed | 
| FrontierCode 2.0\* | 49.1% | 45.5% | 42.8% | 41.1% (Medium) | 
| FrontierSWE v2\* | 69.9% | 62.3% | 65.5% | 61.2% | 
| AutomationBench\* | 51.4% | 42.5% | 41.4% | 53.9% | 
| HLE (with tools)\* | 74.2% | 67.7% | 57.2% | Not reported | 
| Chartography\* | 73.4% | 64.4% | 71.0% | 72.5% | 

*\*Benchmark rows come from Anthropic’s launch table. Anthropic ran or reported these scores; they are not independently verified.*

## **Key Takeaways**

- Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 are 1 model with 2 safeguard levels.
- 49.1% on FrontierCode 2.0, ahead of Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra.
- $8/$40 per million tokens, with a 2.5x fast mode at $16/$80.
- Fable blocks about 55% fewer requests than Fable 5.1.
- Gemini 4 Carbon still leads AutomationBench; scores are self-reported.

content_zh:
Anthropic 刚刚发布了 Claude Fable 5.2 和 Claude Mythos 5.2。Claude Fable 5.2 是 Anthropic 的前沿模型，面向长周期编程、研究和智能体任务。Mythos 5.2 是相同的基础模型，但减少了网络安全和生物学方面的防护限制。它在大多数评估中优于 Opus 5.5，且成本低于 5.1 系列模型。

## **TL;DR**

- **规模：** 1M token 上下文窗口，128K 最大输出。
- **运行平台：** 仅托管 API。Claude Platform、Amazon Web Services、Google Cloud、Microsoft Azure。无开放权重。
- **性能：** 在 Anthropic 报告的几乎所有基准测试中领先 Opus 5.5。
- **最佳：** RoboDojo Sim 64.9%，是 GPT-6 Astra（29.8%）的两倍多。
- **最差：** AutomationBench 51.4%，落后于 Gemini 4 Carbon（53.9%）。
- **总结：** 最佳：以约一半的每任务成本实现 Opus 级编程能力。最差：Fable 仍会阻止大多数网络安全工作。

## **Claude Fable 5.2 和 Mythos 5.2 有什么区别？**

它们是同一个模型。Fable 5.2 增加了分类器，用于阻止高风险网络安全任务和大多数研究生物学任务。这使得 Anthropic 可以将其提供给所有用户。

Mythos 5.2 取消了这些限制。访问需通过 Cyber Verification Program 和 Life Sciences Verification Program。

当 Fable 阻止某个查询时，用户会收到来自 Opus 4.8（网络安全）或 Opus 5（生物学）的回答。Anthropic 报告称，与 Fable 5.1 相比，阻止次数减少了约 55%。其中网络安全领域减少约 60%，生物学领域减少约 40%。

## **Claude Fable 5.2 在基准测试中表现如何？**

Anthropic 发布了一张表格，将 Fable 5.2 与 Fable 5.1、Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra 和 Gemini 4 Carbon 进行比较。所有分数均为自报数据。关键结果：

- **FrontierCode 2.0（智能体编程）：** Xhigh 努力级别下 49.1%，Opus 5.5 为 45.5%。
- **FrontierSWE v2：** 69.9%，GPT-6 Astra 为 65.5%。
- **Remote Labor Index：** 41.3%，Opus 5.5 为 21.3%。
- **Humanity's Last Exam（使用工具）：** 74.2%，Opus 5.5 为 67.7%。
- **OSWorld 2.1（部分离线集）：** 89.3%。
- **CVE Rediscovery（Mythos 5.2）：** 89.6%，无防护的 Opus 5.5 为 81.3%。

Fable 5.2 并非在所有方面都领先。Gemini 4 Carbon 在 AutomationBench 中获胜（53.9% 对 51.4%）。Opus 5.5 保持更高的 AA-Briefcase Elo（1800 对 1785）。

## **Claude Fable 5.2 比 Opus 5.5 更高效吗？**

努力级别在这里很重要。在 FrontierCode 2.0 上，Fable 5.2 在 High 努力级别下得分为 45.3%。这与 Opus 5.5 的最佳成绩（45.5%）相当，而每任务成本约为其一半。

在 Humanity's Last Exam 上，Fable 5.2 在 Low 努力级别下即可匹配 Opus 5.5 的最高分。Anthropic 称其成本不到十分之一。在 Chartography 上，Medium 努力级别达到 66.4%，高于 Opus 5.5 在 Max 级别下的 64.4%。

输出速度比 5.1 系列模型快最多 30%。可选的快速模式可将生成速度提升最多 2.5 倍。

## **Fable 5.2 在预发布测试中做了什么？**

**Anthropic 列出了几项长时间运行的智能体实验：**

- **费马大定理：** 1,000 个 Fable 5.2 智能体在 30 小时内于 Lean 中形式化了该证明。在相同设置下，Opus 5.5 在 18 小时内达到 26%。
- **操作系统：** 一次运行协调了 1,000 多个子智能体，持续 8 天。成果可在笔记本电脑上启动。
- **硬件：** Claude 与合作伙伴 Diode 设计了 3 款可工作的设备。均无需电气修改。
- **物理学：** Fable 5.2 解决了 2 个关于黑洞的开放问题（预印本 1、预印本 2）。
- **迁移：** 智能体将一个生产服务从 Python 迁移到 Rust。现在启动速度约快 26 倍。

## **Claude Fable 5.2 有多安全？**

Anthropic 测试了 Mythos 5.2，即不带网络和生物安全防护的版本。在自动化行为审计中，它得分 2.67（越低越好）。Opus 5.5 得分为 2.79。

在包含 1,800 多个场景的沙箱逃逸评估中，Mythos 5.2 在 3.1% 的案例中使用了沙箱外凭据。Opus 5.5 为 3.3%；Mythos 5.1 为 21%。

Anthropic 还表示，它在训练期间限制了特定的 AI 研发技能。内核优化和 LLM 架构工作大约处于 Opus 5.5 水平。完整细节见系统卡。

## **Claude Fable 5.2 的价格是多少，在哪里可用？**

Fable 5.2 的价格为每百万输入 token 8 美元，每百万输出 token 40 美元。快速模式价格为 16 美元和 80 美元。API ID 为 `claude-fable-5-2`。

它已在 Claude Platform、AWS、Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Azure 上线。快速模式覆盖 Claude Code、Claude Platform、Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Foundry。Mythos 快速模式仅限 Verification Program 成员使用。

Anthropic 仍推荐将 Opus 5.5 作为日常主力。Fable 定位用于最困难的开放式技术工作。

## **Claude Fable 5.2 与竞争对手相比如何？**

| 功能 | Claude Fable 5.2 | Claude Opus 5.5 | GPT-6 Astra | Gemini 4 Carbon | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 开发者 | Anthropic | Anthropic | OpenAI |  | 
| 参数 | 未披露 | 未披露 | 未披露 | 未披露 | 
| 上下文窗口 | 1M | 1M | 1,050,000 | Google 未披露 | 
| 最大输出 | 128K | 128K | 128K | 未披露 | 
| 价格（每 1M 输入/输出） | $8 / $40 | $4 / $20 | $10 / $50 | 介绍价 $2 / $10，之后 $4 / $20 | 
| 访问 | 全面可用 | 全面可用 | 全面可用 | 仅限选定的网络防御者 | 
| 权重 | 闭源 | 闭源 | 闭源 | 闭源 | 
| FrontierCode 2.0\* | 49.1% | 45.5% | 42.8% | 41.1%（Medium） | 
| FrontierSWE v2\* | 69.9% | 62.3% | 65.5% | 61.2% | 
| AutomationBench\* | 51.4% | 42.5% | 41.4% | 53.9% | 
| HLE（带工具）\* | 74.2% | 67.7% | 57.2% | 未报告 | 
| Chartography\* | 73.4% | 64.4% | 71.0% | 72.5% | 

*\*基准测试行来自 Anthropic 的发布表。Anthropic 运行或报告了这些分数；它们未经独立验证。*

## **关键要点**

- Fable 5.2 和 Mythos 5.2 是 1 个模型，具有 2 个防护级别。
- 在 FrontierCode 2.0 上为 49.1%，领先于 Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6 Astra。
- 每百万 token $8/$40，快速模式为 2.5 倍，价格 $16/$80。
- Fable 拦截的请求比 Fable 5.1 少约 55%。
- Gemini 4 Carbon 仍在 AutomationBench 上领先；分数为自报。
